q: The relative entropy rate of process P w.r.t. process Q satisfies D̄(P||Q) = lim_{n→∞} (1/n) D(P^n||Q^n). For ergodic processes, this equals:
opts: The asymptotic expected log-likelihood ratio per symbol
exp: By Birkhoff ergodic theorem, (1/n)log(dP^n/dQ^n) → D̄(P||Q) a.s. under P. The relative entropy rate is the a.s. limit of the normalised log-likelihood ratio—the per-symbol KL divergence between stationary processes.
